problem.passage:
Urban planners studying commuter behavior in a mid-sized city argued that adding a dedicated bus lane on a congested corridor would reduce average commute times more effectively than adding a general-purpose traffic lane. They based this claim on data from cities that had implemented similar bus lanes: in each case, average bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent within a year, even as car traffic in adjacent lanes increased slightly. The planners also pointed out that ridership on the affected routes rose substantially after the bus lanes opened, which they attributed to the improved reliability of bus schedules rather than to any change in fares. Critics of the proposal countered that the corridor in question already had lower bus ridership than the cities studied, and that a new general-purpose lane might relieve car congestion more directly, though no data from comparable general-lane expansions were presented.

Which quotation from the passage most effectively illustrates the planners' claim that dedicated bus lanes improve commute times more than adding car lanes would?
problem.stimulus: Urban planners studying commuter behavior in a mid-sized city argued that adding a dedicated bus lane on a congested corridor would reduce average commute times more effectively than adding a general-purpose traffic lane. They based this claim on data from cities that had implemented similar bus lanes: in each case, average bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent within a year, even as car traffic in adjacent lanes increased slightly. The planners also pointed out that ridership on the affected routes rose substantially after the bus lanes opened, which they attributed to the improved reliability of bus schedules rather than to any change in fares. Critics of the proposal countered that the corridor in question already had lower bus ridership than the cities studied, and that a new general-purpose lane might relieve car congestion more directly, though no data from comparable general-lane expansions were presented.
problem.question: Which quotation from the passage most effectively illustrates the planners' claim that dedicated bus lanes improve commute times more than adding car lanes would?
options: "average bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent within a year, even as car traffic in adjacent lanes increased slightly"
"ridership on the affected routes rose substantially after the bus lanes opened"
"the corridor in question already had lower bus ridership than the cities studied"
"a new general-purpose lane might relieve car congestion more directly"
problem.explanation: 정답 A는 버스 전용 차선 도입 후 실제로 통행 시간이 줄었다는 구체적 수치를 제시하며, 이는 '전용 차선이 통근 시간을 더 효과적으로 줄인다'는 주장을 직접 뒷받침한다. B는 승차율 증가를 보여주지만, 이는 통근 시간 단축 효과 자체가 아니라 별개의 결과(이용자 수 변화)를 가리킨다. C는 비판자들이 언급한 세부사항으로, 오히려 계획안에 대한 반박 근거이다. D 역시 비판자들의 주장으로 일반 차선 확장을 옹호하는 내용이라 계획자들의 주장과 반대된다.
problem.explanationEn: Choice A gives concrete data showing that bus travel times actually decreased after dedicated lanes were added, directly supporting the claim that such lanes reduce commute times more effectively. Choice B shows increased ridership, which reflects a different outcome (usage) rather than travel-time improvement itself. Choice C is a detail raised by critics and actually undercuts the planners' proposal. Choice D is also part of the critics' counterargument favoring a general lane, which opposes the planners' claim.
problem.evidenceTarget: Dedicated bus lanes reduce commute times more effectively than adding a general-purpose traffic lane would.
problem.evidenceSpan: average bus travel times fell by at least 15 percent within a year, even as car traffic in adjacent lanes increased slightly
problem.answerRationale: 버스 전용 차선 도입 후 버스 통행 시간이 유의미하게 줄었고, 동시에 일반 차량 정체가 늘었음에도 이런 개선이 나타났다는 사실은 버스 전용 차선이 통근 시간 단축에 직접적으로 기여했다는 주장을 뒷받침한다.

difficultyReasons: 정답을 찾기 위해 '주장(통근시간 개선)'과 '근거(구체적 수치)'를 연결하는 1~2단계 추론이 필요함
오답 B는 정답과 같은 화자(계획자)의 발언이라 화자 구분만으로는 걸러지지 않고, 주장의 초점(통근시간 vs 승차율)을 구분해야 함
오답 C, D는 화자가 다르다는 점(비판자 발언)을 파악해야 하므로 화자 관점 구분이 필요함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 버스 노선 이용 증가는 버스전용차로 정책의 성공을 보여주는 것처럼 보여 관련 있어 보인다
distractors.matches: 지문의 'ridership on the affected routes rose substantially after the bus lanes opened' 부분과 정확히 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 이 인용은 통근 시간 개선이 아니라 승차율(수요) 증가를 설명하는 것으로, 질문이 요구하는 '통근 시간 개선' 주장과 직접 연결되지 않는다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 비판자들이 언급한 내용이라 지문에 등장하지만, 얼핏 보면 버스 관련 통계처럼 보일 수 있다
distractors.matches: 지문의 비판자 발언 'the corridor in question already had lower bus ridership than the cities studied'와 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 이는 비판자의 반박 근거이며 계획자들의 주장(통근 시간 단축)을 뒷받침하는 것이 아니라 오히려 그 적용 가능성에 의문을 제기하는 내용이다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 차량 정체 완화에 관한 내용이라 통근 시간과 관련 있어 보일 수 있다
distractors.matches: 지문의 비판자 발언 'a new general-purpose lane might relieve car congestion more directly'와 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 이는 비판자의 반대 주장으로, 오히려 일반차로 확장이 더 효과적일 수 있다는 상반된 입장이며 데이터도 없다고 명시됨
